title: Model routing gets a clearer map
summary:
Model choices and aliases got a reshuffle, while tier tracking and API guidance became less reliant on guesswork.

Registry changes updated text-model selections and aliases, moved `openai-large` to `gpt-5-chat-latest`, restored Kontext to the seed-tier image configuration, and added `gptimage` aliases. Invalid service IDs and missing model IDs are now caught rather than silently falling through; configuration checks use the production registry definitions.

Enter now stores a user's tier in their auth session and uses it for generation tracking instead of reading it from response data. It also forwards the tier to generation backends. This change does not add tier-based usage enforcement.

The docs now spell out GPT-5's temperature and `top_p` limitations, warn against requesting system prompts from reasoning models, and offer a tip for prompting verbatim TTS output. Contributor-attribution guidance was also added.

highlights.title: Openai-large changes models
highlights.text: `openai-large` now maps to `gpt-5-chat-latest`, and its model definition no longer has a 20,000-character input cap. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-large).

highlights.title: Kontext returns to image config
highlights.text: Kontext is back in the seed-tier image model configuration, with a 1216-pixel maximum side length. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=kontext).

highlights.title: New gptimage aliases
highlights.text: The image registry now recognizes `gptimage`, with `gpt-image` and `gpt-image-1-mini` as aliases. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gptimage).
